name: Azooma Escape - أهرب من العزومة
detailed_description:
Dodge, hide, and outwit your relatives in Azooma Escape - a fast-paced, top-down stealth comedy set amid the chaos of a Saudi family festival! Outrun food-wielding relatives, slip past nosy situations, and make your epic getaway before you become the center of attention.

Survive the Festival. Outsmart Your Family.

When your uncle’s big celebration transforms your peaceful village into the ultimate social ambush, only cunning and stealth will keep your freedom (and sanity) intact. Every room holds gossip, surprise performances, and a maze of over-eager hosts determined to keep you fed and involved.

Will you stealthily congratulate your uncle and escape unseen or find yourself trapped in a mystical twist?

Every second you stay hidden is a victory... until someone unravels your escape plan.

EMBRACE THE CHAOS

Stealth game veterans: forget guards with flashlights!

Here, the real threat is the culinary gangster with a plate of food and a heart full of hospitality!

Duck under tables, crouch behind furniture, and use the chaos of the festival to slip through undetected… just don’t let them see you!

Every escape in this stealth comedy game has its obstacles, but in this Saudi festival village, they rarely look like trouble… at first.

The host whose master plan could rival a king’s treasury. The street performer whose dazzling act turns your quiet getaway into tonight’s headline. The relative whose endless demands make slipping away feel like an Olympic sport. And somewhere beyond the music and laughter, the faint stir of something older, stranger, lurking just out of sight ready to turn your family escape into a whole new kind of chase.

Outsmarting the festival means outsmarting personalities bigger than the celebration itself.

YOUR ARSENAL OF AVOIDANCE

  • Table Cover – Slip under tables and low furniture to avoid being spotted.

  • Crouch & Dodge – Stay low, sidestep, and weave your way around the busiest rooms.

  • Pattern Reading – Learn each relative’s route and habits to slip through unnoticed.

Last Resort: Tea Cup Takedown – Spot pursuer, aim, throw. Nothing stops a determined chaser faster than a flying cup of steamingly empty teacup.

THE WORLD OF AZOOMA

Explore bustling courtyards and lively, chatter-filled living rooms in a vibrant Saudi village, rich with cultural celebration and everyday life.

But stay alert. Uncle Shaddad’s Culinary Gangsters have placed the village under lockdown, transforming alleys, courtyards, and rooms into watchful traps. One wrong step and you’ll be swept into the chaotic festival, where every laugh, drumbeat, and whisper brings a fresh stealth challenge.

In Azooma Escape, the world is more than just a setting, you have to outsmart every corner of this lively festival village before it swallows you whole.

FEATURES

  • Fast-paced stealth gameplay with a cultural twist

  • Interactive environments full of hiding opportunities

  • Relatives that are both hilarious and terrifying in equal measure

  • A lighthearted story of festival-scale family chaos

In Arabic, “Azooma” means gathering or invitation and here, it’s both your mission and your greatest threat.
Will you slip through the crowd and escape the ultimate social ambush… or get pulled into another round of tea and small talk?

Perfect for stealth fans, cultural comedy lovers, and anyone who’s ever hidden just to avoid a chatty relative.

short_description: "Azooma Escape" is a fast-paced, comedic stealth adventure where a young boy tries to sneak out of an overly generous gathering before being force-fed hospitality. Navigate crowded rooms, dodge aggressive hosts, and solve puzzles in a hilarious, culturally inspired escape mission.
